name: An Evening Encounter
source:
It's a quiet Friday evening, and you find a familiar stranger intruding on your usual haunt.

...But hey, maybe this is the perfect opportunity to finally get to know them.

Time to make a new friend.

[From [url=https://itsu-saragi.itch.io/an-evening-encounter]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这是一个安静的周五晚上，你发现一个熟悉的陌生人闯入了你常去的地方。

…但是，嘿，也许这是最终了解他们的绝佳机会。

是时候结交新朋友了。

[来自[url=https://itsu-saragi.itch.io/an-evening-encounter]itch.io[/url]]
